name: Alphalete Trenchless (Hub)
body:
> Hub · Alphalete · 2026-10-22

Alphalete Trenchless Services is a Colorado Springs trenchless sewer repair and CIPP lining company (716 Clark Pl, Ste 160) serving the Front Range and Denver metro, with five services: residential and commercial trenchless pipelining, sewer camera inspection, hydro jetting and drain cleaning. The site (alphaletetrenchless.com) is WordPress + Elementor on Hostinger. Since late July 2026 the only SEO layer is Search Atlas MetaSync/OTTO (Rank Math and Yoast are off). The story so far: a rebuilt site with about 237 mostly programmatic local pages that Google would not index (3 indexed in June), fixed step by step through redirects, a sitemap repair, root city pages and blog growth to about 50 posts, reaching 108 of 111 tracked URLs indexed by late September. Open threads: one official phone number, GA4 key events, authority, and local proof on city pages.
